title: [master] Remittance Advice Report (ID 10083) prints Amount Due = 0 when using Suggest Vendor Payments with Summarize Per Vendor
summary: Report 10083 now correctly displays the Amount Due field when generating remittance advice with vendor payments summarized per vendor, fixing an issue where the field appeared as zero due to a missing field calculation.
key_points: Added Remaining Amt. (LCY) to CalcFields in the Vendor Ledger Entry dataitem
Resolves incorrect zero amount display in Export Electronic Payments report
Affects vendor payment processing workflows using Summarize Per Vendor option
Test coverage added to prevent regression
quote: The report uses Remaining Amt. (LCY) without calculating this FlowField in the Vendor Ledger Entry dataitem.
